label: YAP1::MAMLD1

sections.text: YAP1 encodes a transcriptional coactivator regulated by Hippo signaling.
MAMLD1 encodes a transcriptional regulator involved in developmental gene expression.

The fusion preserves YAP1 transcriptional coactivation in a persistently nuclear product that recruits TEAD and nuclear-factor-I factors. It drives the YAP1-fusion-positive ependymoma group, most often encountered in young children.
